```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Load data

```{r}
df_loss <- 
  # read_rds("data_out/df_analysis.rds") %>% 
  read_rds("data_out/df_fu_analysis.rds") %>% 
  filter(age_loss <= 20.5) # Get rid of unwanted comparison groups
```

Function for fixed effect model

```{r}
run_fixed_logist <- function(outc_var){
  
  # Construct formula
  formula <- paste0(outc_var, "~age_loss_cat|fam_link")

  # Fit model
  fit <-
   fixest::feglm(as.formula(formula),
                 family = "binomial",
                 data = df_loss)

  # Return coefficients
  parameters::parameters(fit, keep = "age_loss_cat", exp = T) %>% 
    as_tibble() %>% 
    mutate(age_cat = str_remove(Parameter, "age_loss_cat") %>% as.numeric())
}

run_surv <- function(fu_var){
  
  # Binary outcome variable (e.g is_dep)
  outc_var <- paste0("is_", str_remove(fu_var, "fu_"))

  # Construct formula
  formula <- paste0("survival::Surv(fu_start,", fu_var, ", event = ", outc_var, ") ~ 
                    age_loss_cat + strata(fam_link)")

  
  # Fit model
  fit_surv <-
    survival::coxph(as.formula(formula),
                    data = df_loss)

  # Return coefficients
  parameters::parameters(fit_surv, keep = "age_loss_cat", exp = T) %>% 
    as_tibble() %>% 
    mutate(age_cat = str_remove(Parameter, "age_loss_cat") %>% as.numeric())
}
```

Run models

```{r}
outc_cols <- 
  df_loss %>%
  select(matches("is_.+anytime_all")) %>%
  colnames()

df_coeffs <-
  tibble(outc_var = outc_cols) %>%
  mutate(coeffs = map(outc_var, run_fixed_logist)) %>% 
  unnest(coeffs)
```

Format

```{r}
df_coeffs_fmt <-
  df_coeffs %>% 
  mutate(outc = case_when(str_detect(outc_var, "anypsy") ~ "Any psychiatric disorder",
                          str_detect(outc_var, "dep") ~ "Depression",
                          str_detect(outc_var, "anx") ~ "Anxiety",
                          str_detect(outc_var, "sub") ~ "Substance abuse",
                          str_detect(outc_var, "bip") ~ "Bipolar disorder",
                          str_detect(outc_var, "neu") ~ "Neurodevelopmental disorder",
                          str_detect(outc_var, "per") ~ "Personality disorder",
                          str_detect(outc_var, "psc") ~ "Psychotic disorder",
                          str_detect(outc_var, "sle") ~ "Sleep disorder",
                          str_detect(outc_var, "str") ~ "Stress-related disorder",
                          )) 
```

### Plot

Any mental illness

```{r}
plt_any <-
  df_coeffs_fmt %>% 
  filter(outc == "Any psychiatric disorder") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age_cat, 
             y = Coefficient,
             ymin = CI_low,
             ymax = CI_high)) +
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 1/4, color = "gray", fill =NA, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red2", linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 18, alpha = .3, linewidth = 20) +
  annotate("text", x = 18, y = 9, label = "Reference age group",
           angle = 270, size = 4) +
  facet_wrap(~outc, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 18, by = 2),
                     labels = c(seq(0, 16, by = 2), "18-20"),
                     limits = c(0, 18)) +
  labs(x = "Age at parental loss", y = "Odds ratio") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Specific diagnoses

```{r}
plt_diag <-
  df_coeffs_fmt %>% 
  filter(outc != "Any psychiatric disorder") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = age_cat, 
             y = Coefficient,
             ymin = CI_low,
             ymax = CI_high)) +
  geom_ribbon(alpha = 1/4, color = "gray", fill =NA, linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "red2", linetype = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 18, alpha = .3, linewidth = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~outc, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 20, by = 4),
                     labels = c(seq(0, 16, by = 4), "18-20"),
                     limits = c(0, 18)) +
  labs(x = "Age at parental loss", y = "Odds ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  
```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=7}
patchwork::wrap_plots(plt_any, plt_diag, 
                      ncol = 1, heights = c(1/2, 1)) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')
```
